target_stats.note: length parity and the length lower bound are syntactically visible reachability filters; see receipt

chart_D.reference_size_note: M1 denominators must use an entropy-coded size (lzma of the sparse COO) so that generic sparsity is not credited as structure

edge_table.key: one row per nominal legal action (s, rule, position)

fields.dst_forward_region: int32 forward-reachable set size from dst (target-independent)

edge_target_table.key: (edge row, target column); only rows with D[src,t] >= 0 are live

fields.dD: int8: D[dst,t]-D[src,t] when both live; +127 = target lost (trap); -128 = source not live (entry inert)

mask_proposal.hash_scheme: states: sha256('AC01|<universe>|state|<word>'); entries: sha256('AC01|<universe>|entry|<word>|<target>'); target columns: sha256('AC01|target|<target>') (universe-independent); first 12 hex digits / 16^12; roles by split fractions
